source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch sets shared h1 and h2 sizes to 2em and 1.5em, and body tables to 1em. about:support separately gives major-section headings 1.5em; the actual h2 markup uses that class. The shared file is reached through the global in-content common-skin override and platform imports. The accepted source retains em. This records the local declarations and consumers, not a global em rule, a complete page cascade audit or measured font rendering.
title: The about-page font patch uses em in shared headings and the support-page override
